presentation.label: Four mute modes
presentation.summary: Choose a stock cut, FX tails, trig suppression or amp-envelope completion for muted and soloed-out audio tracks.
presentation.overview: Choose a stock cut, FX tails, trig suppression or amp-envelope completion for muted and soloed-out audio tracks.
highlights: OT is the default. The global PERSONALIZE setting is stored in battery SRAM; it is not a Part or project setting.
An OS upgrade resets PERSONALIZE. Saving or switching Parts/projects does not make the mode project-specific.
SIDECHAIN_COMPRESSOR requires its SC_KEY assembly variant so a muted key continues feeding the compressor.
usage: Open PROJECT > SYSTEM > PERSONALIZE and select MUTE MODE.
Choose OTFX to cut the dry signal while delay and reverb tails continue; trigs keep firing underneath.
Mute and unmute an audio track with a long delay or reverb tail, then try OTFX-T to suppress new trigs.
Choose DT-T to let the current voice finish its amp envelope, or OT to restore the stock cut.

controls.name: MUTE MODE
controls.doc: Global PERSONALIZE selection; YES wraps, LEFT/RIGHT clamp.

limitations: OT is the default. The global PERSONALIZE setting is stored in battery SRAM; it is not a Part or project setting.
An OS upgrade resets PERSONALIZE. Saving or switching Parts/projects does not make the mode project-specific.
SIDECHAIN_COMPRESSOR requires its SC_KEY assembly variant so a muted key continues feeding the compressor.
No effect slot is consumed. Audio tracks and solo exclusions are affected; MIDI track mute behavior is unchanged.

resources.recorded: 7 October 2026; authored-source assembly and isolated native-code probes

storage.label: Authored code and relocated menu tables
storage.conditions: Program bytes 1176, tables 204. This is a standalone source footprint, not a complete common-builder or stock memory inventory. Actual probe stack peaks and model timing are recorded separately.

processing.label: ColdFire native paths
processing.display: Measured model cycles; chip wall-clock pending
processing.conditions: MCF5206E core-cycle model, cache-hit zero-wait; not MCF54455 chip timing. Synthetic stock callbacks exclude their actual work. Conservative V4 code-cycle path bounds exclude cache, bus and interrupt contention; see TESTING.md.

impact.conditions: Source estimate for eight audio tracks; no added DSP program. Complete timing and placement remain pending.

cpu.rationale: Finite ColdFire hook paths with bounded eight-track loops; native paths and stack peaks were measured.

dsp.rationale: No new DSP program; existing voice and FX dispatch is retained.

memory.rationale: Small authored ROM patches and reused stock state; no new audio buffer allocation.

tests.summary: All three author SHA-256 references match. Native mask/mode/menu/sidechain probes passed with measured instruction counts, model cycles and stack peaks. Actual LCD menu/mode captures were reviewed. Full audio, complete callback timing and current-image hardware remain pending. Published with owner approval for missing hardware evidence; historical author reports are retained. Software integration is checked separately.

tutorial.title: Quick tutorial: keep FX tails when muting
steps: Open PROJECT > SYSTEM > PERSONALIZE and select MUTE MODE.
Choose OTFX to cut the dry signal while delay and reverb tails continue; trigs keep firing underneath.
Mute and unmute an audio track with a long delay or reverb tail, then try OTFX-T to suppress new trigs.
Choose DT-T to let the current voice finish its amp envelope, or OT to restore the stock cut.
